violations.message: C1 sits in series between +3.3V and U1.8; U1 only gets power through a capacitor, which blocks DC.
violations.why: A capacitor blocks DC, so the chip never gets steady power and won't turn on. Decoupling caps go in parallel, power to ground, to absorb fast current spikes at the chip.
violations.fix_hint: Connect U1.8 directly to +3.3V, then rewire C1 so one pin is on +3.3V and the other is on GND.
